text: It's called Prism. A free, open source alternative to Internet Download Manager.
Your browser pulls a file through one single connection. And a lot of servers cap the speed of each one.
So Prism splits that same file into up to thirty two parts, and pulls them all at once.
When one part finishes early, it takes over half of the biggest part still left. Nothing sits idle.
It grabs videos too. YouTube and eighteen hundred other sites, up to 8K, or just the MP3.
Laptop dies halfway? It picks up exactly where it stopped.
It even does torrents, and Hugging Face models.
One honest catch. If your own internet is the slow part, no app can fix that.
Send this to the friend who's still waiting on a download.
Comment PRISM, and I'll send you the link.
